description: Land Title Settlement Department - Nivithigala, Nivithigala D/S Division, Ratnapura District - Cad. Map No. 620400
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act, No. 21 of 1998. It contains declarations of determination for specific land parcels (including parcel numbers, extents, owner details, and title classifications) in the Nivithigala area. The content focuses on land ownership registration, title settlement, and property rights - all falling squarely within the Land Gazette classification category. There are no government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or other non-land related administrative matters present.
